name: Competitor launched a feature
summary: When a competitor's changelog or blog shows a launch, decide whether we're better or missing it. Better: draft a blog post, a LinkedIn post and ad copy. Missing: alert the product team and draft a sales FAQ. Drafts wait for approval.
publishesTo: Google Docs (blog draft, ad copy, sales FAQ)

inputs.label: Product team Slack webhook URL
inputs.help: Where 'they shipped something we don't have' alerts go.

inputs.label: Only these competitors
inputs.help: Comma-separated names from the Competitors page. Blank = all.

config.system: You are a product marketing analyst. Judge only from our product facts and positioning; if unsure whether we have something, say missing.

config.prompt:
A competitor just launched {{outputs.assess.data.feature}}, which we already do well. Write a 500–700 word blog post about how we approach this problem and why it matters to customers. Don't attack the competitor. Title on the first line.

Context: {{outputs.assess.data.reasoning}}

config.system: You write LinkedIn posts for our company.
config.prompt:
Write a LinkedIn post (under 120 words) on why {{outputs.assess.data.feature}} matters and how we approach it. No hashtag walls, at most two hashtags.

Context: {{outputs.assess.data.reasoning}}

Write 3 ad variants (headline up to 30 characters, description up to 90) positioning us on {{outputs.assess.data.feature}}.

Context: {{outputs.assess.data.reasoning}}

A competitor launched {{outputs.assess.data.feature}}, which we don't have. Write a short sales FAQ: 4–6 likely customer questions with honest answers. Never promise roadmap dates or features.

Context: {{outputs.assess.data.reasoning}}
